title: DynaRev: Benchmarking Web Agents under Dynamic Goal Revision
title_zh: DynaRev：在动态目标修订下对网页智能体进行基准测试

paragraphs.en: Web agents are typically evaluated with goals fully specified before execution and fixed thereafter, whereas real users often revise their requirements during interaction. To study such interactions, we introduce DynaRev , a benchmark of 181 tasks to evaluate web agents under dynamic goal revision . DynaRev uses semantic milestones to deliver revisions at task-defined stages, covers additive revisions, unconditional overrides, and runtime-conditioned overrides, and evaluates correctness, responsiveness, and efficiency through trajectory-grounded evaluation. Five-model evaluations show that agents often satisfy only part of the task requirements, with performance varying across task sources, revision types, and models. Further analyses reveal varied milestone timing, mixed effects of dynamic delivery, and contrasting revision-handling outcomes, with gains from instruction rewriting while preserving browser state and losses from browser resets. DynaRev provides a testbed for studying how web agents adapt to evolving user goals. The code and data are available at https://github.com/zsq259/DynaRev .
paragraphs.zh: 网页智能体通常在执行前目标已完全确定且此后保持不变的情况下进行评估，而真实用户往往会在交互过程中修改其需求。 为研究此类交互，我们提出了 DynaRev，这是一个包含 181 个任务的基准，用于在动态目标修订下评估网页智能体。 DynaRev 利用语义里程碑在任务定义的阶段发布修订，涵盖追加式修订、无条件覆盖和运行时条件覆盖，并通过基于轨迹的评估来衡量正确性、响应性和效率。 五个模型的评估表明，智能体往往只能满足部分任务要求，其性能在任务来源、修订类型和模型之间有所不同。 进一步的分析揭示了里程碑发布时机的差异、动态发布的混合影响以及截然不同的修订处理结果：在保留浏览器状态的前提下进行指令改写带来收益，而重置浏览器则造成损失。 DynaRev 为研究网页智能体如何适应不断变化的用户目标提供了一个测试平台。 代码和数据可在 https://github.com/zsq259/DynaRev 获取。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled autonomous agents to perceive, reason, plan, and act in complex digital environments ( Ning et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2025 ; Mei et al., 2025 ) . Among them, web agents interact with website interfaces through human-like actions such as clicking, typing, and scrolling, allowing them to operate websites without relying on dedicated APIs ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Lai et al., 2024 ) . They support a wide range of practical tasks such as information seeking, online shopping, travel planning, and service navigation. With increasingly capable foundation models and agent frameworks, web agents are now able to execute complex multi-step tasks in realistic environments ( Gur et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展使自主智能体能够在复杂的数字环境中进行感知、推理、规划和行动（Ning et al., 2025；Xi et al., 2025；Mei et al., 2025）。 其中，网页智能体通过点击、输入和滚动等类人操作与网站界面交互，使其无需依赖专用API即可操作网站（Zheng et al., 2024；Lai et al., 2024）。 它们支持诸如信息检索、在线购物、旅行规划和服务导航等广泛的实际任务。 随着基础模型和智能体框架能力的不断提升，网页智能体现在能够在真实环境中执行复杂的多步骤任务（Gur et al., 2024；He et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: However, most web-agent tasks assume that the user’s goal is fully specified before execution and remains fixed throughout the interaction ( Deng et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Xue et al., 2025 ; Gou et al., 2025 ) . Real-world user goals are often more dynamic. For example, a user may first ask an agent to find a flight from Los Angeles to Boston, then add “Avoid overnight flights” after viewing the candidates, revise this preference to “If daytime flights cost more than $150 extra, overnight flights are acceptable,” and later request nonstop flights only. Such interactions are not merely a fixed instruction split across multiple turns: later instructions may add new constraints, override previously active ones, or introduce requirements that apply conditionally based on the web state observed during execution. We refer to this setting as dynamic goal revision .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，大多数网络智能体任务都假设用户目标在执行前已被完整指定，并在整个交互过程中保持不变（Deng et al., 2023；Zhou et al., 2024；Koh et al., 2024；He et al., 2024；Xue et al., 2025；Gou et al., 2025）。 现实世界中的用户目标往往更加动态。 例如，用户可能先让智能体查找一趟从洛杉矶到波士顿的航班，然后在查看候选结果后补充“避免红眼航班”，接着将该偏好修改为“如果白天航班需要额外支付超过150美元，红眼航班也可以接受”，之后又要求只看直飞航班。 这类交互并非只是把固定指令拆分到多轮中进行：后续指令可能会添加新的约束，覆盖先前生效的约束，或者引入基于执行过程中观察到的网页状态而条件性生效的要求。 我们将这种设定称为动态目标修订。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has begun to recognize goal adaptation as an important agent capability. AgentChangeBench ( Rana et al., 2025 ) studies goal shifts in conversational tool-using agents, DeskCraft ( Wang et al., 2026 ) considers interruptions and corrections in desktop workflows, and InterruptBench ( Zou et al., 2026 ) evaluates additions, revisions, and retractions in long-horizon web navigation. However, three gaps remain in web settings. First, revisions are often injected based on relative trajectory progress rather than task-semantic progress, so agents following different paths may receive the same revision at different task stages. Second, existing settings largely omit conditional revisions whose applicability depends on the web state. Finally, evaluations mainly assess task-level success and recovery cost, with limited analysis of revision-level constraint satisfaction, post-revision responsiveness, and cost–quality trade-offs.
paragraphs.zh: 近期工作已开始将目标适应视为一项重要的智能体能力。 AgentChangeBench（Rana et al., 2025）研究对话式工具使用智能体中的目标变化，DeskCraft（Wang et al., 2026）考察桌面工作流中的中断与更正，InterruptBench（Zou et al., 2026）评估长程网页导航中的新增、修改与撤回。 然而，在网页场景中仍存在三个缺口。 首先，修改往往是基于相对轨迹进度而非任务语义进度注入的，因此遵循不同路径的智能体可能在不同的任务阶段收到相同的修改。 其次，现有设置在很大程度上忽略了其适用性取决于网页状态的条件性修改。 最后，评估主要关注任务层面的成功与恢复成本，而对修改层面的约束满足、修改后的响应性以及成本—质量权衡的分析有限。

paragraphs.en: To address these gaps, we introduce DynaRev , a benchmark for evaluating web agents under dynamic goal revisions. DynaRev uses semantic milestones , task-defined stages of the current goal, to trigger revisions independently of the execution path, and covers additive, unconditional-override, and conditional-override revisions, with conditional branches resolved from the web state. We develop a revision-aware, trajectory-grounded evaluation framework that assesses answer correctness, revision responsiveness, and cost-aware efficiency.

paragraphs.en: We construct 181 dynamic tasks from Online-Mind2Web ( Xue et al., 2025 ) and Mind2Web 2 ( Gou et al., 2025 ) , and evaluate five models. Agents often satisfy only part of the task requirements, with performance varying across task sources, revision types, and models. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in milestone timing and mixed effects of dynamic delivery, while instruction rewriting with preserved browser state improves quality and efficiency and browser resets degrade performance. These results reveal behaviors missed by static evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 Online-Mind2Web（Xue et al., 2025）和 Mind2Web 2（Gou et al., 2025）中构建了 181 个动态任务，并评估了五个模型。 智能体往往只能满足任务要求的一部分，其表现因任务来源、修订类型和模型而异。 进一步的分析揭示了里程碑时间的显著差异以及动态交付的混合效应，而在保留浏览器状态的情况下改写指令可以提高质量和效率，浏览器重置则会降低性能。 这些结果揭示了静态评估所遗漏的行为。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold: (i) We formulate dynamic goal revision for web agents and introduce semantic milestone-based revision delivery. (ii) We construct DynaRev , covering additive revisions, unconditional overrides, and runtime-conditioned overrides. (iii) We develop a revision-aware, trajectory-grounded evaluation assessing correctness, responsiveness, and efficiency.

paragraphs.en: GUI agents interact with graphical interfaces through actions such as clicking, typing, and scrolling to complete user tasks ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Nguyen et al., 2025 ) . web agents instantiate this setting in browser environments, where agents can also use structured page representations such as HTML and accessibility trees. Representative systems such as SeeAct ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) and WebVoyager ( He et al., 2024 ) demonstrate LLM-based agents operating on real websites. We focus on web agents as the evaluation setting in this work, while dynamic goal revision is relevant to GUI agents more broadly.

paragraphs.en: The evaluation of web-agents has progressed from offline action prediction to interactive and real-world execution. Mind2Web ( Deng et al., 2023 ) evaluates agents against human interaction trajectories, while WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) and VisualWebArena ( Koh et al., 2024 ) provide interactive sandbox environments with functional evaluation. WorkArena ( Drouin et al., 2024 ) and WorkArena++ ( Boisvert et al., 2024 ) extend evaluation to enterprise workflows and compositional tasks. WebVoyager ( He et al., 2024 ) extends evaluation to live websites, and more recent benchmarks such as Online-Mind2Web ( Xue et al., 2025 ) and Mind2Web 2 ( Gou et al., 2025 ) further improve task realism and outcome verification. Despite these differences, their tasks generally specify the complete user objective before execution and keep it unchanged throughout the interaction.

paragraphs.en: Multi-turn interaction has been studied in both web and general agent settings. paragraphs.en: Related settings have emerged for GUI agents, including ReInAgent ( Jia et al., 2025 ) , DeskCraft ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and most closely, InterruptBench ( Zou et al., 2026 ) , which evaluates user additions, revisions, and retractions during long-horizon web navigation. paragraphs.en: Recent work has moved beyond binary final-task success. Mind2Web 2 ( Gou et al., 2025 ) decomposes complex requirements into fine-grained criteria, while ProBench ( Yang et al., 2026 ) evaluates intermediate process information. Dynamic-goal benchmarks also consider adaptation, such as goal-shift recovery in AgentChangeBench ( Rana et al., 2025 ) and post-interruption success and execution cost in InterruptBench ( Zou et al., 2026 ) . Our evaluation binds atomic constraints to individual revisions and verifies them using the agent’s final response and trajectory, while assessing post-revision responsiveness and cost-aware efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的工作已经超越了二元最终任务成功的评价方式。 Mind2Web 2（Gou et al., 2025）将复杂需求分解为细粒度的标准，而 ProBench（Yang et al., 2026）则评估中间过程信息。 动态目标型基准还考虑了适应能力，例如 AgentChangeBench（Rana et al., 2025）中的目标变更恢复，以及 InterruptBench（Zou et al., 2026）中的中断后成功率和执行成本。 我们的评估将原子约束绑定到各次修订，并利用智能体的最终回复和轨迹加以验证，同时评估修订后的响应能力和成本感知的效率。

paragraphs.en: Using the same flight request, we consider three forms of revision. An additive revision introduces a new constraint while preserving previously active constraints, e.g., “Only consider nonstop flights.” An unconditional override replaces a previously active constraint with a new one, e.g., “Actually, choose an overnight flight instead.” A conditional override replaces a previously active constraint with an alternative only when a specified runtime condition is satisfied, e.g., “If daytime flights cost more than $150 extra, overnight flights are acceptable.” In a conditional override, the agent must determine the applicable branch and corresponding active constraints from the web state, rather than receiving them from the revision.
paragraphs.zh: 使用同一个航班请求，我们考虑三种形式的修订。 附加式修订在保留先前生效约束的同时引入一个新约束，例如“只考虑直飞航班”。无条件覆盖式修订用一个新约束替换先前生效的约束，例如“其实，改选夜间航班吧”。条件覆盖式修订仅在满足指定的运行时条件时，才用一个替代约束替换先前生效的约束，例如“如果白天的航班需要多付超过 150 美元，那么夜间航班也可以接受”。在条件覆盖式修订中，智能体必须从网页状态中判断适用的分支及相应的生效约束，而不是直接从修订中获得它们。

paragraphs.en: The remaining constraints are organized into a sequence of revisions according to a natural interaction order. paragraphs.en: Generated tasks are checked for both structural validity and interaction naturalness. The initial instruction must express a coherent executable goal, while subsequent revisions must introduce meaningful changes rather than artificial fragments of the original instruction. Milestones must describe semantic stages implied by preceding goals and remain independent of a particular reference trajectory or future revision. For conditional overrides, the triggering condition must be observable from the runtime environment. We additionally verify the consistency between revisions and their associated constraints. Tasks that fail these checks are regenerated or excluded from the benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的任务会同时进行结构有效性和交互自然度的检查。 初始指令必须表达一个连贯且可执行的目标，而后续修订必须引入有意义的变化，而不是对原始指令进行人为的碎片化拆分。 里程碑必须描述前序目标所蕴含的语义阶段，并且独立于特定的参考轨迹或未来的修订。 对于条件覆盖，触发条件必须能从运行时环境中观测到。 我们还验证了修订与其相关约束之间的一致性。 未通过这些检查的任务将被重新生成或从基准中剔除。

paragraphs.en: Following the Agent-as-a-Judge paradigm ( Zhuge et al., 2025 ; Gou et al., 2025 ) , we evaluate each constraint using the agent’s final response and interaction trajectory. paragraphs.en: Each constraint is decomposed into independently verifiable claims. paragraphs.en: Accounting for execution cost reveals different budget–performance profiles across agents. GPT uses the fewest action steps (24.9) but has the lowest overall Score (0.598), whereas DeepSeek achieves higher correctness (0.698) with more steps (43.0); nevertheless, their step-based CE is nearly identical (0.477 vs. 0.482). Gemini combines the highest correctness with the second-lowest average action count (33.1 steps) and therefore achieves the highest CE under both action-step and token costs. The cost–quality curves in Figure 4 further show that GPT accumulates performance rapidly under small budgets but plateaus relatively early, while Gemini and DeepSeek continue to improve as additional budget becomes available.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑执行成本后，不同智能体呈现出不同的预算—性能表现。 GPT 使用的动作步骤最少（24.9），但总体得分最低（0.598）；而 DeepSeek 以更多步骤（43.0）取得了更高的正确率（0.698）；然而，两者基于步骤的成本效率几乎相同（0.477 对 0.482）。 Gemini 将最高正确率与第二低的平均动作次数（33.1 步）相结合，因此在动作步骤和 token 两种成本下都取得了最高的成本效率。 图 4 中的成本—质量曲线进一步表明，GPT 在小预算下性能提升迅速，但较早进入平台期；而 Gemini 和 DeepSeek 则随着预算的增加继续改进。

paragraphs.en: We compare 30 additive tasks with their original single-turn counterparts, with 15 tasks from each source. The two settings share the same final requirements and execution budget, differing only in whether the requirements are given upfront or progressively during execution. Table 5 shows no uniform effect on correctness: GPT and Qwen improve on both sources, Claude declines on both, while Gemini shows opposite trends across the two sources. paragraphs.en: Trajectory inspection reveals two competing effects. Progressive delivery can reach the final goal through intermediate stages, but it can also introduce rework, interface loops, and budget exhaustion. Thus, dynamic delivery is neither uniformly beneficial nor harmful; instead, it exposes model-dependent execution behaviors that static evaluation may not reveal. Full results are in Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹检查揭示了两种相互竞争的效应。 渐进式交付可以通过中间阶段达到最终目标，但也可能引入返工、接口循环和预算耗尽。 因此，动态交付既不总是有益的，也不总是有害的；相反，它暴露了静态评估可能无法揭示的、依赖于模型的执行行为。 完整结果见附录 F。

paragraphs.en: When a revision is delivered, a natural alternative to continuing from the current execution is to reformulate the updated goal and restart the task. We therefore compare revision-handling strategies along three dimensions: instruction representation (original vs. rewritten), interaction history (retained vs. cleared), and browser state (continued vs. reset). We consider six meaningful combinations, excluding configurations that reset the browser while retaining interaction history. The baseline retains the original instructions, interaction history, and browser state, corresponding to direct continuation from the current execution. We evaluate all strategies with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on the same subset of benchmark tasks. Strategy changes are applied only when a revision is delivered, and all configurations share the same 100-step budget. Table 6 reports task quality and execution cost.
paragraphs.zh: 当收到修订时，继续当前执行之外的一个自然替代方案是重新表述更新后的目标并重新开始任务。 因此，我们从三个维度比较修订处理策略：指令表示（原始 vs. 重写）、交互历史（保留 vs. 清空）以及浏览器状态（延续 vs. 重置）。 我们考虑六种有意义的组合，排除了在重置浏览器的同时保留交互历史的配置。 基线保留原始指令、交互历史和浏览器状态，对应于从当前执行直接延续。 我们在相同的基准任务子集上使用 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 评估所有策略。 仅在收到修订时才应用策略变更，并且所有配置共享相同的 100 步预算。 表 6 报告了任务质量和执行成本。

paragraphs.en: Rewriting the accumulated instructions while preserving the ongoing execution gives the best overall trade-off, increasing Score from 0.647 to 0.718 while reducing both action steps (50.3 to 44.9) and token usage (806.7k to 658.8k). Clearing interaction history alone leaves task quality nearly unchanged (0.648 vs. 0.647) and reduces token usage, but requires more actions. In contrast, resetting the browser consistently worsens the overall quality–cost trade-off: Reset lowers Score to 0.586 and increases steps to 59.7, while Reset + Rewrite further reduces Score to 0.525 and requires the most steps. Comparing Clear with Reset, and Clear + Rewrite with Reset + Rewrite, indicates that retaining the current browser state provides substantial reusable execution progress. Overall, the results favor reorganizing the accumulated goal while continuing from the current execution, rather than treating each revision as a new task.
paragraphs.zh: 在保留正在进行的执行的同时重写累积的指令能带来最佳的整体权衡，将 Score 从 0.647 提升至 0.718，同时减少了动作步骤数（从 50.3 降至 44.9）和 token 用量（从 806.7k 降至 658.8k）。 仅清除交互历史几乎不改变任务质量（0.648 对比 0.647），并能减少 token 用量，但需要更多的动作。 相比之下，重置浏览器始终会恶化整体的质量–成本权衡：Reset 将 Score 降至 0.586，并将步骤数增加到 59.7，而 Reset + Rewrite 进一步将 Score 降至 0.525，且需要最多的步骤。 将 Clear 与 Reset 进行比较，以及将 Clear + Rewrite 与 Reset + Rewrite 进行比较，表明保留当前浏览器状态能提供大量可复用的执行进度。 总体而言，结果更倾向于在从当前执行继续的同时重组累积的目标，而不是把每次修订当作一个新任务。

paragraphs.en: We inspect trajectories to understand the quantitative patterns. Figure 5 shows three representative failure modes. paragraphs.en: We introduced DynaRev , a benchmark to assess web agents under dynamic goal revisions, featuring semantic milestone triggers, runtime-conditioned overrides, and fine-grained evaluation of correctness, responsiveness, and efficiency. Experiments with five models show that immediate adaptation does not ensure final constraint satisfaction. Further analyses reveal timing mismatches between fixed-position and milestone-based revisions, while instruction rewriting while preserving browser state improves task quality and efficiency. Our benchmark provides a foundation for studying web agents’ ability to handle evolving user goals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DynaRev，一个用于评估智能体在动态目标修订下表现的基准，其特点是具有语义里程碑触发器、基于运行时条件的覆盖机制，以及对正确性、响应性和效率的细粒度评估。 对五个模型的实验表明，即时适应并不能确保最终满足约束条件。 进一步的分析揭示了固定位置修订与基于里程碑的修订之间的时机不匹配问题，而在保留浏览器状态的同时进行指令改写则能提升任务质量和效率。 我们的基准为研究智能体处理不断演变的用户目标的能力奠定了基础。

paragraphs.en: We acknowledge the limitations of this work. (i) Our benchmark is constructed from static web tasks and may not capture the full diversity of real-world goal changes. (ii) Milestone triggering and evaluation rely on imperfect LLM-based semantic judgments. (iii) Semantic milestones assume that meaningful intermediate task stages can be identified, which may be harder for tasks with highly diverse successful trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们承认本工作的局限性。 (i) 我们的基准由静态网络任务构建而成，可能无法完全捕捉现实世界中目标变化的多样性。 (ii) 里程碑的触发与评估依赖于并不完善的基于大语言模型的语义判断。 (iii) 语义里程碑假设能够识别出有意义的中间任务阶段，这对于成功轨迹高度多样的任务而言可能更加困难。

paragraphs.en: This section provides additional details for the static-to-dynamic task transformation described in Section 4. The construction procedure follows five stages: constraint decomposition, initial instruction construction, revision and milestone organization, quality control, and constraint binding.
paragraphs.zh: 本节为第 4 节所述的静态到动态任务转换提供更多细节。 构建流程包括五个阶段：约束分解、初始指令构建、修订与里程碑组织、质量控制以及约束绑定。

sents.en: This section provides additional details for the static-to-dynamic task transformation described in Section 4.
sents.zh: 本节为第 4 节所述的静态到动态任务转换提供更多细节。

sents.en: The construction procedure follows five stages: constraint decomposition, initial instruction construction, revision and milestone organization, quality control, and constraint binding.
sents.zh: 构建流程包括五个阶段：约束分解、初始指令构建、修订与里程碑组织、质量控制以及约束绑定。

paragraphs.en: We first decompose each source task into a set of atomic constraints. Each constraint describes a single independently verifiable requirement and is designed to avoid semantic overlap with the others. The resulting constraints serve as the shared units for subsequent revision construction and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先将每个源任务分解为一组原子约束。 每个约束描述单个可独立验证的要求，并被设计为避免与其他约束产生语义重叠。 所得到的约束作为后续修订构建与评估的共享单元。

sents.zh: 我们首先将每个源任务分解为一组原子约束。

paragraphs.en: Tasks with too few constraints to support meaningful multi-round decomposition are excluded at this stage. This prevents the construction procedure from producing artificial revisions by fragmenting a goal that is naturally expressed in a single turn.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一阶段，约束过少而无法支持有意义的多轮分解的任务会被排除。 这可以防止构建过程通过拆分本可以在单轮中自然表达的目标来产生人为的修订。

paragraphs.en: The milestone description also avoids unnecessarily requiring a specific result configuration. For example, completing a search stage can constitute a milestone even if the search returns no matching candidates. This distinction prevents milestone triggering from depending on incidental properties of the current web state rather than on task progress itself.
paragraphs.zh: 里程碑描述还应避免不必要地要求特定的结果配置。 例如，即使搜索没有返回匹配的候选结果，完成一个搜索阶段也可以构成一个里程碑。 这种区分可防止里程碑的触发依赖于当前网页状态的偶然属性，而不是任务进度本身。

paragraphs.en: For tasks containing override revisions, we distinguish between core and preference constraints. Core constraints define the fundamental task object or objective, such as the target product category, search subject, or destination. Preference constraints describe attributes that users may naturally revise during execution, such as color, price range, rating, or ranking preference. Override revisions are constructed only from preference constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 对于包含覆盖式修订的任务，我们区分核心约束与偏好约束。 核心约束定义任务的基本对象或目标，例如目标产品类别、搜索主题或目的地。 偏好约束描述用户在执行过程中可能自然修改的属性，例如颜色、价格区间、评分或排序偏好。 覆盖式修订仅由偏好约束构建。

paragraphs.en: The construction of an unconditional override is separated into replacement planning and timeline organization. We first select an eligible preference constraint and choose an alternative value from the same semantic dimension. Replacement candidates are primarily collected from values observed in the source tasks; when the available candidates are insufficient, additional alternatives in the same semantic dimension are generated and reviewed for consistency with the task context.
paragraphs.zh: 无条件覆盖的构建被分为替换规划和时间线组织两部分。 我们首先选择一个符合条件的偏好约束，并从同一语义维度中选择一个替代值。 替换候选值主要从源任务中观察到的值收集；当可用候选值不足时，会生成同一语义维度中的额外替代值，并检查其与任务上下文的一致性。

sents.zh: 无条件覆盖的构建被分为替换规划和时间线组织两部分。

sents.en: We first select an eligible preference constraint and choose an alternative value from the same semantic dimension.
sents.zh: 我们首先选择一个符合条件的偏好约束，并从同一语义维度中选择一个替代值。

sents.en: Replacement candidates are primarily collected from values observed in the source tasks; when the available candidates are insufficient, additional alternatives in the same semantic dimension are generated and reviewed for consistency with the task context.
sents.zh: 替换候选值主要从源任务中观察到的值收集；当可用候选值不足时，会生成同一语义维度中的额外替代值，并检查其与任务上下文的一致性。

paragraphs.en: The selected original preference and its replacement are then incorporated into the multi-round timeline. The original preference is introduced before the override, while the later revision explicitly replaces it with the new requirement. Separating replacement selection from timeline generation reduces interference between deciding what should change and deciding when and how that change should be expressed.
paragraphs.zh: 选定的原始偏好及其替换内容随后被纳入多轮时间线中。 原始偏好先于覆盖内容被引入，而后续的修订则明确地用新需求将其替换。 将替换选择与时间线生成分开，可以减少「决定应该改变什么」与「决定何时以及如何表达该改变」之间的相互干扰。

sents.en: The selected original preference and its replacement are then incorporated into the multi-round timeline.
sents.zh: 选定的原始偏好及其替换内容随后被纳入多轮时间线中。

paragraphs.en: Conditional overrides retain the original preference as the default requirement and activate an alternative only when a specified runtime condition is satisfied. The condition must be observable from the web environment during execution and should introduce an additional environment-state judgment rather than reducing to a direct restatement of the preference replacement itself.
paragraphs.zh: 条件性覆盖将原始偏好保留为默认要求，仅在满足指定的运行时条件时才激活替代方案。 该条件必须在执行期间可从 Web 环境中观察到，并且应引入额外的环境状态判断，而不是简化为对偏好替换本身的直接重述。

sents.en: Conditional overrides retain the original preference as the default requirement and activate an alternative only when a specified runtime condition is satisfied.
sents.zh: 条件性覆盖将原始偏好保留为默认要求，仅在满足指定的运行时条件时才激活替代方案。

paragraphs.en: We consider two types of conditions. Numerical-threshold conditions are defined over observable quantities such as price differences, rating differences, or distance, and activate the alternative branch when the relevant value crosses a specified threshold. Existence conditions depend on whether a particular type of option is available, such as whether an item is in stock or whether a direct flight exists.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑两类条件。 数值阈值条件定义在诸如价格差异、评分差异或距离等可观测量的之上，当相关数值越过指定阈值时激活备选分支。 存在性条件取决于某一特定类型的选项是否可用，例如某件商品是否有货，或者是否存在直飞航班。

sents.en: We consider two types of conditions.
sents.zh: 我们考虑两类条件。

sents.en: Numerical-threshold conditions are defined over observable quantities such as price differences, rating differences, or distance, and activate the alternative branch when the relevant value crosses a specified threshold.

sents.zh: 存在性条件取决于某一特定类型的选项是否可用，例如某件商品是否有货，或者是否存在直飞航班。

paragraphs.en: For conditional-override construction, the selected replacement pair is combined with a condition appropriate to the task context and constraint dimension, and the resulting branch structure is then incorporated into the multi-round timeline.
paragraphs.zh: 对于条件覆盖构建，所选的替换对会与适合任务上下文和约束维度的条件相结合，随后将生成的分支结构纳入多轮时间线中。

paragraphs.en: Generated tasks are reviewed for both structural validity and interaction naturalness. The initial instruction must specify a coherent executable goal, while subsequent revisions must introduce meaningful changes rather than artificial fragments of the source instruction. Milestones must describe semantic stages implied by previously specified goals, remain independent of the upcoming revision, and avoid dependence on a particular sequence of UI operations.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的任务会从结构有效性和交互自然度两方面进行审查。 初始指令必须指定一个连贯的可执行目标，而后续修改必须引入有意义的变化，而不是对源指令的人为拼凑片段。 里程碑必须描述先前指定目标所蕴含的语义阶段，与即将进行的修改保持独立，并避免依赖于特定的 UI 操作序列。

sents.en: Generated tasks are reviewed for both structural validity and interaction naturalness.
sents.zh: 生成的任务会从结构有效性和交互自然度两方面进行审查。

paragraphs.en: For conditional overrides, the runtime condition must be observable from the web environment and the alternative branch must remain meaningful in the underlying task context. We also check the consistency of the revision sequence and the constraints that it is intended to introduce or modify.
paragraphs.zh: 对于条件覆盖，运行时条件必须能够从网页环境中观察到，并且替代分支在底层任务上下文中必须保持有意义。 我们还检查修订序列的一致性，以及其旨在引入或修改的约束条件。

sents.en: For conditional overrides, the runtime condition must be observable from the web environment and the alternative branch must remain meaningful in the underlying task context.
sents.zh: 对于条件覆盖，运行时条件必须能够从网页环境中观察到，并且替代分支在底层任务上下文中必须保持有意义。

paragraphs.en: When an instance fails these checks, the relevant construction stage is regenerated. Tasks that remain invalid after the prescribed retries are excluded from the final benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 当一个实例未通过这些检查时，将重新生成相应的构建阶段。 在规定的重试次数后仍然无效的任务将从最终基准测试中排除。

sents.zh: 在规定的重试次数后仍然无效的任务将从最终基准测试中排除。

paragraphs.en: After a task passes quality control, each atomic constraint is bound to the instruction that introduces or modifies it. This correspondence records the provenance of each evaluation requirement and allows the evaluation pipeline to distinguish constraints associated with different stages of goal evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 任务通过质量控制后，每条原子约束都会与引入或修改它的指令进行绑定。 这种对应关系记录了每条评估要求的来源，并使评估流程能够区分与目标演化不同阶段相关联的约束。

sents.zh: 任务通过质量控制后，每条原子约束都会与引入或修改它的指令进行绑定。

paragraphs.en: Constraint binding is performed as a separate post-processing stage rather than jointly with revision generation. Generating revisions and bindings simultaneously may encourage artificially regular partitions in which each revision is constructed merely to correspond to a convenient subset of constraints. Separating the two stages allows revision construction to prioritize natural interaction structure while preserving an explicit instruction–constraint correspondence for later evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 约束绑定作为一个独立的后期处理阶段执行，而不是与修订生成联合进行。 同时生成修订和绑定可能会促成人为规则化的划分，其中每个修订的构建仅仅是为了对应一个方便的约束子集。 将两个阶段分离，可以使修订的构建优先考虑自然的交互结构，同时保留明确的指令—约束对应关系，以便后续评估使用。

paragraphs.en: At each step, the agent receives the accumulated user instructions, the complete action history, and web observations from the interaction trajectory. To control context growth, we retain the full web observations for only the five most recent interaction steps. Earlier observations are replaced with a fixed placeholder, while their corresponding actions remain in the context. Thus, the complete instruction and action histories are preserved throughout execution, while detailed web-state history is maintained within a fixed recent window.
paragraphs.zh: 在每一步，智能体接收累积的用户指令、完整的动作历史，以及来自交互轨迹的网页观察。 为了控制上下文的增长，我们仅对最近的五个交互步骤保留完整的网页观察。 更早的观察会被替换为固定占位符，而其对应的动作仍保留在上下文中。 因此，完整的指令和动作历史在整个执行过程中得以保留，而详细的网页状态历史则在一个固定的近期窗口内维护。

sents.en: At each step, the agent receives the accumulated user instructions, the complete action history, and web observations from the interaction trajectory.
sents.zh: 在每一步，智能体接收累积的用户指令、完整的动作历史，以及来自交互轨迹的网页观察。

sents.en: To control context growth, we retain the full web observations for only the five most recent interaction steps.
sents.zh: 为了控制上下文的增长，我们仅对最近的五个交互步骤保留完整的网页观察。

sents.en: Earlier observations are replaced with a fixed placeholder, while their corresponding actions remain in the context.
sents.zh: 更早的观察会被替换为固定占位符，而其对应的动作仍保留在上下文中。

sents.en: Thus, the complete instruction and action histories are preserved throughout execution, while detailed web-state history is maintained within a fixed recent window.
sents.zh: 因此，完整的指令和动作历史在整个执行过程中得以保留，而详细的网页状态历史则在一个固定的近期窗口内维护。

paragraphs.en: Revisions are delivered when their corresponding semantic milestones are reached. If the agent declares completion while revisions remain pending and execution budget remains, the completion is intercepted, the next pending revision is delivered, and execution continues.
paragraphs.zh: 修订版本会在达到相应的语义里程碑时交付。 如果智能体在仍有修订版本待交付且执行预算尚有剩余时宣告完成，该完成声明将被拦截，下一个待交付的修订版本会被交付，执行继续进行。

sents.en: Revisions are delivered when their corresponding semantic milestones are reached.
sents.zh: 修订版本会在达到相应的语义里程碑时交付。

paragraphs.en: A run terminates when the agent calls done after all revisions have been delivered, or when the maximum execution step limit is reached.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体在交付所有修订后调用 done，或者达到最大执行步数限制时，一次运行（run）即告终止。

paragraphs.en: This section provides implementation details omitted from Section 5 , focusing on claim construction, trajectory evidence retrieval, and post-revision behavioral assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 本节提供了第 5 节中省略的实现细节，重点围绕论点构建、轨迹证据检索以及修订后的行为评估。

paragraphs.en: For each constraint to be evaluated, the claim generator receives the constraint, the agent’s final response, and the task context, and produces one or more independently verifiable claims together with their verification types. For constraints containing relative-time expressions, we additionally provide the task execution date to resolve the temporal reference.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个待评估的约束，声明生成器接收该约束、智能体的最终回答以及任务上下文，并生成一个或多个可独立验证的声明及其验证类型。 对于包含相对时间表达式的约束，我们额外提供任务执行日期以解析时间参照。

sents.en: For each constraint to be evaluated, the claim generator receives the constraint, the agent’s final response, and the task context, and produces one or more independently verifiable claims together with their verification types.
sents.zh: 对于每个待评估的约束，声明生成器接收该约束、智能体的最终回答以及任务上下文，并生成一个或多个可独立验证的声明及其验证类型。

sents.en: For constraints containing relative-time expressions, we additionally provide the task execution date to resolve the temporal reference.
sents.zh: 对于包含相对时间表达式的约束，我们额外提供任务执行日期以解析时间参照。

paragraphs.en: Claim decomposition is used when a single constraint requires multiple verification instances. For example, if a constraint requires every returned hotel to provide free breakfast, the evaluator generates a separate claim for each returned hotel. This allows each hotel to be verified independently while preserving the original constraint as a single task requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 当单个约束需要多个验证实例时，会使用声明分解。 例如，如果某约束要求每个返回的酒店都提供免费早餐，评估器会为每个返回的酒店生成一个单独的声明。 这样可以在保留原始约束作为单一任务要求的同时，对每家酒店进行独立验证。

paragraphs.en: Claims of type simple are verified directly from the agent’s final response, whereas page claims are passed to the trajectory evidence retrieval procedure described below.
paragraphs.zh: simple 类型的声明直接从智能体的最终回答中进行验证，而 page 类型的声明则被传递到下文所述的轨迹证据检索流程中。

paragraphs.en: For each page claim, we first identify the subject whose property or web evidence must be verified. We then inspect the final recorded web state. If it already provides sufficient evidence, the claim is verified directly from this state.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个页面声明，我们首先识别其属性或网页证据需要被验证的主体。 然后我们检查最终记录的网页状态。 如果它已经提供了充分的证据，该声明就直接从这个状态得到验证。

sents.en: For each page claim, we first identify the subject whose property or web evidence must be verified.
sents.zh: 对于每个页面声明，我们首先识别其属性或网页证据需要被验证的主体。

sents.en: We then inspect the final recorded web state.
sents.zh: 然后我们检查最终记录的网页状态。

sents.en: If it already provides sufficient evidence, the claim is verified directly from this state.
sents.zh: 如果它已经提供了充分的证据，该声明就直接从这个状态得到验证。

paragraphs.en: Otherwise, we search the trajectory beginning from the delivery of the instruction to which the constraint is bound. The claim subject is used as an anchor for lightweight lexical matching over subsequent web states, producing a small set of candidate states. Only these candidates are passed to the page verifier.
paragraphs.zh: 否则，我们从约束所绑定的指令被下发处开始搜索轨迹。 声明主题被用作锚点，对后续网页状态进行轻量级词法匹配，从而产生一个小规模的候选状态集合。 只有这些候选状态会被传递给页面验证器。

sents.en: Otherwise, we search the trajectory beginning from the delivery of the instruction to which the constraint is bound.
sents.zh: 否则，我们从约束所绑定的指令被下发处开始搜索轨迹。

sents.en: The claim subject is used as an anchor for lightweight lexical matching over subsequent web states, producing a small set of candidate states.
sents.zh: 声明主题被用作锚点，对后续网页状态进行轻量级词法匹配，从而产生一个小规模的候选状态集合。

sents.en: Only these candidates are passed to the page verifier.
sents.zh: 只有这些候选状态会被传递给页面验证器。

paragraphs.en: A lexical match is used only for candidate retrieval and is not itself treated as evidence. Candidate states are examined in trajectory order, and the first state judged to provide sufficient evidence is used to verify the claim. If no retrieved state provides sufficient evidence, the page claim is treated as unverified.
paragraphs.zh: 词汇匹配仅用于候选检索，其本身不被视为证据。 候选状态按轨迹顺序进行检查，第一个被判定为提供充分证据的状态用于验证该声明。 如果没有任何检索到的状态提供充分证据，则该页面声明被视为未验证。

paragraphs.en: For each delivered revision, we examine at most the next three agent actions, stopping earlier if another revision is delivered or the task terminates. The resulting action window is evaluated by the behavioral judge to determine whether the agent responds consistently with the revised intent.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每一次交付的修订，我们最多检查接下来的三个智能体动作，若期间再次交付修订或任务终止，则提前停止。 得到的动作窗口由行为裁判进行评估，以判断智能体的回应是否与修订后的意图保持一致。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a small manual inspection of milestone-trigger timing on 30 sampled cases. For each trigger, annotators inspect the milestone description, the web state at which the revision is triggered, and the immediately preceding state. They independently answer two binary questions: (Q1) whether the milestone is satisfied at the trigger state, and (Q2) whether it was already satisfied at the preceding state. We derive a three-way timing label from these judgments: a trigger is early if the milestone is not yet satisfied at the trigger state, aligned if it is satisfied at the trigger state but not at the preceding state, and late if it was already satisfied one step earlier.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 30 个抽样案例的里程碑触发时机进行了小规模人工检查。 对于每个触发，标注者会检查里程碑描述、触发修订时的网页状态，以及紧邻的前一个状态。 他们独立回答两个二选一的问题：(Q1) 里程碑在触发状态时是否已满足，(Q2) 在前一个状态时是否已满足。 我们根据这些判断得出三分类的时机标签：如果里程碑在触发状态时尚未满足，则该触发为过早（early）；如果在触发状态时已满足但在前一个状态时未满足，则为对齐（aligned）；如果在前一个状态时便已满足，则为过晚（late）。
